    inline int add(int x) { return x >= MOD ? x - MOD : x; }
    inline int sub(int x) { return x < 0 ? x + MOD : x; }
    inline int mul(int x, int y) { return (long long) x * y % MOD; }
}

struct Matrix {
    int a[MAXN][MAXN];
    int size;
    void init() { memset(a, 0, sizeof a); }
    void set_identity() {
        init();
        for (int i = 1; i <= size; ++i) {
            a[i][i] = 1;
        }
    }
    Matrix operator*(const Matrix &rhs) const {
        Matrix result;
        result.size = size;
        static long long tmp[MAXN][MAXN];
        const long long MODLL = (long long)MOD * MOD;
        for (int i = 1; i <= size; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= size; ++j)
                tmp[i][j] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= size; ++i)
            for (int k = 1; k <= size; ++k)
                for (int j = 1; j <= size; ++j) {
                    tmp[i][j] += (long long)a[i][k] * rhs.a[k][j];
                    if (tmp[i][j] >= MODLL) tmp[i][j] -= MODLL;
                }
        for (int i = 1; i <= size; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= size; ++j)
                result.a[i][j] = tmp[i][j] % MOD;
        return result;
    }
};

        temp_n /= k;
    }

    int max_k = k + 1;
    f.assign(cnt, vector<Matrix>(k));
    sump.assign(cnt, vector<Matrix>(k));
    sums.assign(cnt, vector<Matrix>(k));

    for (int i = 0; i < cnt; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
            f[i][j].size = max_k;
            f[i][j].init();
            for (int x = 1; x <= max_k; ++x) {
                f[i][j].a[x][x] = 1;
                if (x == j + 1) {
                    f[i][j].a[j + 1][x] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Initialize prefix and suffix products
    for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
        sump[0][j] = f[0][j];
        sums[0][j] = f[0][j];
    }

    for (int i = 1; i < cnt; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
            if (j == 0)
                f[i][j] = sums[i - 1][j];
            else

            else

            if (j == k - 1)
                sums[i][j] = f[i][j];
            else
                sums[i][j] = sums[i][j + 1] * f[i][j];
        }
